stories.tz: 蒂努布总统沙特之行将“为尼日利亚祈祷”
stories.sz: 他上一次前往麦加是在2022年竞选尼日利亚总统期间。

stories.t: Inside the Russia-Africa summit in Moscow
stories.s: More than 20 heads of state arrived at the summit.
stories.tz: 直击莫斯科俄非峰会
stories.sz: 20多位国家元首出席了此次峰会。

stories.t: GDP report to give insight before Election Day. And, Israel's election is deadlocked
stories.s: Economists expect the GDP report to show economic growth, but say that growth is "fragile." And, after 90% of the votes in Israel have been counted, no clear winner has emerged.
stories.tz: GDP报告为大选日提供经济前瞻，以色列选举陷入僵局
stories.sz: 经济学家预计GDP报告将显示经济增长，但称这种增长是“脆弱的”。此外，在以色列统计了90%的选票后，仍未出现明显的赢家。

stories.t: Audio reveals exchanges between Spain train operators and drivers moments before deadly crash
stories.s: The leaked tapes appear to show one high-speed train was given clearance to move at normal speed, even though another up ahead had stalled.
stories.tz: 音频揭示致命撞车事故发生前西班牙列车运营商与司机的对话
stories.sz: 泄露的录音显示，尽管前方有列车抛锚，但一辆高速列车似乎仍获准以正常速度行驶。

stories.t: Ship reported on fire off Oman as Iran escalation fears mount
stories.s: A ship in the Strait of Hormuz is reported to be on fire, a British maritime agency says. Iran has meanwhile said it has shot down another US drone as military tensions with Washington continue.
stories.tz: 阿曼湾一艘船只据报起火，美伊紧张局势升级引发担忧
stories.sz: 英国海上机构称，霍尔木兹海峡一艘船只据报起火。与此同时，随着与华盛顿的军事紧张局势持续，伊朗表示已击落另一架美国无人机。

stories.t: Hong Kong's leader apologises for deadly high-rise fire
stories.s: The massive blaze at Wang Fuk Court in November 2025 was the deadliest the city had seen in decades.
stories.tz: 香港特区行政长官就致命高层建筑火灾道歉
stories.sz: 2025年11月宏福苑发生的这场特大火灾是该市几十年来最致命的火灾。

stories.t: Audacious Indian jailbreak saga ends with 17 prisoners recaptured
stories.s: The jailbreak began with a fake seizure and ended 36 hours later with all the inmates back behind bars.
stories.tz: 印度越狱事件告一段落：17名逃犯全部被重新抓获
stories.sz: 这场越狱事件始于一次伪造的扣押，在36小时后以所有囚犯重回狱中告终。

stories.t: How could Israel break election deadlock? Here are four scenarios
stories.s: With more than 90% of votes counted, all signs point to an impasse. The most likely outcome may be new elections.
stories.tz: 以色列如何打破选举僵局？以下是四种可能的情景
stories.sz: 随着90%以上的选票清点完毕，种种迹象表明选举陷入僵局。最可能的结果或许是重新举行大选。

stories.t: How AI drones are influencing the course of the Ukraine war
stories.s: Artificial intelligence is making drones faster and more capable. Russia and Ukraine both use AI-powered drones, and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has warned that AI could lead decisions on the battlefield as soon as next year.
stories.tz: 人工智能无人机如何影响乌克兰战争进程
stories.sz: 人工智能正在使无人机速度更快、性能更强。俄乌双方都在使用AI赋能的无人机，乌克兰总统泽连斯基警告称，最快到明年，AI就可能主导战场决策。

stories.t: Ethiopia acquires Russian fighter jets and air defence systems amid war in Tigray
stories.s: The acquisition of the warplanes comes amid ongoing fighting in northern Tigray region that started last month.
stories.tz: 提格雷战事持续之际，埃塞俄比亚采购俄制战机和防空系统
stories.sz: 这批战机的采购正值北部提格雷地区自上月爆发的冲突持续之际。

stories.t: Hello Kitty maker cuts ties with Japanese spy drama after China backlash
stories.s: Sanrio has apologised after its merchandise line with Japanese TV series Vivant drew criticism.
stories.tz: 遭中国网民抵制后，《Hello Kitty》母公司取消与日剧间谍剧合作
stories.sz: 在三丽鸥推出与日本电视剧《Vivant》联名的商品系列引发争议后，该公司已公开致歉。

stories.t: El Salvador sends 2,000 troops to Haiti to rescue four missing soldiers
stories.s: The troops are trying to recover four military personnel who went missing in an ambush on the outskirts of the Haitian capital Port-au-Prince.
stories.tz: 萨尔瓦多向海地派遣2000名士兵搜救四名失踪军人
stories.sz: 这批部队正试图搜救在海地首都太子港郊外的一次伏击中失踪的四名军事人员。

stories.t: Spain reckons with 2nd deadly train crash of the year ahead of national election
stories.s: Spain's second high-speed rail disaster this year, a crash in which one train struck another from behind, killing 68 people, has raised fresh concerns about the safety of the country's rail network.
stories.tz: 西班牙在大选前夕迎来该国今年第二起致死列车相撞事故
stories.sz: 这是西班牙今年发生的第二起高铁灾难，一列火车追尾撞击另一列火车导致68人死亡，引发了人们对该国铁路网络安全的新担忧。
